chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Ismail ibn Abdul-Khaliq al-Ju'fi, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Among the survival of the Muslims and the survival of Islam is that wealth should come to be in the hands of one who recognizes the right/truth in it and does good/acts of kindness in it; for among the annihilation of Islam and the annihilation of the Muslims is that wealth should come to be in the hands of one who does not recognize the right/truth in it, nor does he do any act of kindness in it.'

key_terms.الْمَعْرُوفَ: The Known Good / Acts of Kindness / Benevolence

ai.seo_question: What is the sign of Islam's survival and decline according to the distribution of wealth?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes a direct causal link between the vitality of the Islamic community and the moral integrity of its economic stewardship, emphasizing that wealth must be held by those who recognize divine rights (al-haqq) and practice benevolence (al-ma'ruf). This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the interconnection between spiritual purity and social justice, where the mismanagement of resources by the unworthy signals the impending decay (fanā’) of the faith itself. The narration underscores that economic distribution is not merely a logistical matter but a theological indicator of the community's adherence to divine order.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Hareyz, from Ismail Bin Abdul Khaliq Al Ju’fy who said,

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘From the survival of the Muslims and survival of Al-Islam is that the wealth should come to be with the one who recognises the Truth regarding it and does the acts of kindness in it; and from the annihilation (destruction) of Al-Islam and annihilation of the Muslims is that the wealth should come to be in the hands of the one who does not recognise the Truth in it, nor does he do any act of kindness in it’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Hammad ibn ‘Isa from Hariz from Isma‘il ibn ‘Abdul Khaliq al-Ju’fiy who has said the following:

“Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that one of the elements that preserve the Muslims and Islam is when wealth goes to those who understand that there are payable dues on wealth and who make Benevolent Assistance part of their normal practice. One of the destructive elements to Islam and the Muslims is when wealth goes to those who do not acknowledge the existence of any rights due on wealth and who do not make Benevolent Assistance part of their normal practice.”
